title: •Send A Detachment Down
caption: •Send A Detachment Down (V)
game_text: Deploy on opponent’s card (a device, droid, or weapon) that may be stolen by a character. Target your trooper at another location. When reached by target, place this Utinni Effect on target; target is power +2, steals opponent’s card, and you may retrieve 3 Force.
lore: Vader sent Imperial stormtroopers to the surface of Tatooine in search of the stolen Death Star plans. “There’ll be no one to stop us this time.”

notes: Unique (one dot). Icon column empty (only the set symbol); no scomp ring. Lore corrected from scan: the quotation is in curly double quotes “…” and 'There’ll' has a curly apostrophe (wiki uses straight single quotes). Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright year 1995 (Premiere), not legible. Modern: V21-D-sendadetachmentdown.gif (745, Virtual Set 21) used; VB1-D-sendadetachmentdown-pre.gif (350) also downloaded to modern/.
